invariants.rationale: The key parameter is dereferenced, so it must not be null at method entry.
The key is cast to Pair<HoodieKey, Option<HoodieRecordLocation>>, so it must be of type Pair.
The left of the pair is used as HoodieKey, so it must be an instance of HoodieKey.
The right of the pair is assumed to be Option<HoodieRecordLocation>.
